Best Italian pizza in Hanoi
Aug 2026 • Friends
Returning to Hanoi after many years, we decided to stop in for dinner because of the wonderful memories from countless visits over the past 10–25 years during our work in Vietnam. We are so glad we did!

Jesse gave us a warm European-Vietnamese welcome, and our pizza, salad, and drinks arrived promptly and were absolutely on point. This remains one of the very best places in Hanoi for authentic Italian pizza.

Pasta and other dishes did not disappoint! 

If your preference is the thicker, softer pizzas that are common in Vietnam, often topped with sweeter sauces like ketchup or Chin-Su, this may not be your style. But if you’re looking for a genuine Italian-style pizza with a beautifully crisp crust, fresh ingredients, and authentic flavor, you won’t be disappointed.

Right in front of the old cathedral in the old quarter near the lake. Balcony table has awesome view of the church - if the weather suits!

Missed the mark on flavor, waste of our money
Jul 2026 • Couples
We were so excited to eat here, but left disappointed. The food looks good online, but the flavors are just bad when you get it. I am not sure what all the reviews are based on that rank this place so high, maybe they have never had authentic Italian food? The pizza crust was just bland and the lasagna was not edible, it was almost like phyllo dough layers with what I would call Taco Bell tasting meat in between. The bread they bring to the table resembled a hot dog bun and stale matzo crackers.

I hate to leave a bad review, but I wish there was an honest review we saw before we spent so much money here. It was a very expensive place to eat in Hanoi and we didn’t even eat our food, we just paid and left. We tipped the server well, but the food was just inedible unfortunately. 

The atmosphere was great; the service was good too. The food just left too much to be desired.
